To give, grant.

 exchange; {#tileByaH pratiyacCati mAzAn#} <ls>Sk.</ls> --II. €2 <ab>P.</ab> ({#dAti#}) To

 To bind (?). --IV. €3 <ab>U.</ab> ({#dadAti, datte#}; {#dadO-dade, adAt-adita, dAsyati-te#},
 {#dAtum, datta#}; but with {#A#} the {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} is {#Atta#}; with {#upa#},
 {#upAtta#}; with {#ni, nidatta#} or {#nItta#}, and with {#pra, pradatta#} or {#pratta#})
.²1 To give,

 grant, bestow, offer, yield, impart, present (usually with <ab>acc.</ab> of the
 thing and <ab>dat.</ab>, sometimes <ab>gen.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab> also, of the person); {#avakASaM#}
 {#kilodanvAn rAmAyAByarTito dadO#} <ls>R. 4. 58</ls>; {#secanaGawEH bAlapAdapeByaH#}
 {#payo dAtumita evABivartate#} <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 31</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 271</ls>; {#kaTamasya stanaM dAsye#} <ls>Hariv.</ls>
.²2 To pay (as debt, fine <ab>&c.</ab>).
.²3 To hand or deliver over.
.²4 To restore, return.
.²5 To give up, sacrifice, surrender; {#prARAn dA#} to sacrifice oneʼs
 life; so {#AtmAnaM dA#} to sacrifice oneself.
.²6 To put, place, apply, plant; {#karRe karaM dadAti#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²7 To give in marriage; {#yasmE dadyAt pitA tvenAm#} <ls>Ms. 5. 151</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 146</ls>, <ls n="Y.">3. 24</ls>.
.²8 To allow, permit (usually with <ab>inf.</ab>); {#bAzpastu na dadAtyenAM drazwuM#}
 {#citragatAmapi#} <ls>Ś. 6. 22</ls>. (The meanings of this root may be variously
 modified or extended according to the noun with which it is connected;

 <ls>Mu. 2. 5</ls>; {#avakASaM dA#} to give place to, make room; (see {#avakASa#});
